summary: A bare input name as `old` is reported declared at neither tag

evidence.output:
0.14.2.json chart-pin-on-click-default-true: `pinOnClick` is declared at neither tag
0.14.2.json chart-pin-inputs-widened: `pinOnClick` is declared at neither tag
0.14.2.json chart-stagger-default-on: `staggerMs` is declared at neither tag

proposal: Both inputs are declared at both tags (`readonly pinOnClick = input(false, ...)` at v0.14.1, `readonly pinOnClick = input<boolean | null, unknown>(null, {` at v0.14.2), and the member regex at tools/check-manifest-truth.mjs:238 already reads a generic argument and a wrapped initializer. The miss is in `claims()`: a bare camelCase value (line 420) becomes a `symbol` claim, and a symbol resolves only against exported names (line 481), never against element members. Before `declaredAtNeither` reports a bare camelCase `old`, look it up among the members of every element at each tag and resolve it when one declares it.

summary: A rendering change filed informational can regress a screen while the chain is green
proposal: v0.12.2 puts `display: grid` on the `.expand-panel-cell` <td> (absent at v0.12.1), which drops its colspan; the consumer measured the panel 24px wide in a 1559px row. The manifest's informational entry carried the right `verify` and nothing in the workflow performed it. Addressed in plugin 1.10.0: `ds-visual-check` measures every rendering change, `not-applicable` and informational ones included, in the state that shows it.

summary: A class field whose initializer wraps to the next line is invisible
proposal: `FIELD` ended on ` = ` (a space after the `=`), so `private readonly tablist =` followed by a newline never matched. Fixed on dev by `fix/class-surface-wrapped-field` (merge 2819f48b): the pattern ends on `=\s`.
